quote: The whole of Journey to the West just teaches one to be content as a 'Bimawen' — why insist on wreaking havoc in Heaven and fighting for the empty title of 'Victorious Fighting Buddha'?
modern_translation: Stop overworking — isn't a steady job good enough?

role: The sober voice of the world
quote: The road to fetch the scriptures is long — remember to eat first; teams disbanding is the norm; keeping your fallback at Gao Village is the real way to win.
modern_translation: Survival first · keep your exit plan
